title: epilobium glaberrimum subsp. fastigiatum
intro: Epilobium glaberrimum subsp. fastigiatum, commonly known as the narrow-leaved willowherb or narrow-leaved willow herb, is a plant species of the willowherb genus, Epilobium. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in China, for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating properties. The therapeutic actions of Epilobium glaberrimum subsp. fastigiatum are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of the plant's use as a medicinal agent.
